|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Supreme Leader Snoke (Holo AI) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee high-resolution card image of this version ([[:File:V9-D-supremeleadersnoke_ai-2021-08-10-hires.png]]); no card-size GIF of this image was ever committed, which is why it was missing from the version list until the PC's high-resolution images were compared with the card-size images (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-supremeleadersnokeaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/supremeleadersnoke_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/supremeleadersnoke_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Dark Strike”; no “(AI)” label. Text: “If you just initiated a battle where all your ability is provided by First Order characters and/or [First Order] starships, opponent loses 1 Force. If just lost, Kylo is power +3 until end of your next turn. Immune to attrition < 8 (< 4 if with Kylo).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Supreme Leader Snoke (Holo AI) (Errata)]]): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021): re-made for the PC's January 2022 Alternate Image update: the copyright line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd.” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, and the art credit, icons and text box were redrawn or moved; the label “(AI)” now prints. If just lost, Kylo is power +3 until end of your next turn. Immune to attrition < 8 (< 4 if with Kylo).”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Supreme Leader Snoke (Holo AI) (Errata 2)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/supremeleadersnoke_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
